semiconductor_relevance: High — Advantest is a leading manufacturer of automatic test and measurement equipment specifically designed for semiconductor applications.
summary: Advantest (TSE: 6857) specializes in automatic test and measurement equipment used in semiconductor design and production, catering to advanced applications such as 5G, IoT, and AI. The company also engages in R&D to tackle emerging testing challenges and develops solutions for wafer sort and final test processes.
capabilities: Automatic test equipment for semiconductor applications
Advanced test-interface solutions for wafer sort and final test
Scanning electron microscopes for photomask manufacturing

regional_presence.Singapore: Advantest has a presence in Singapore, supporting its global operations and customer base.
